column1: # THE QUALITY BASELINE (quality/ratchet.py update writes it; hooks/pre-push holds every push to it).
# Every function, part and part set past a limit (quality/measure.py), frozen at its value. A row may only fall (update records it); a row added or raised
# lands only in a commit carrying the kind's trailer (`Complexity:`, `Length:`, `Duplication:`, `Coupling:`). CLAUDE.md, "The ratchets".
